summary.zh-TW: 點「Sort by」展開選單，滑鼠移過選項時，同一塊高亮底色跟著滑過去。方向鍵、Enter、Esc 都能操作，點外面會關閉。
summary.en: Click “Sort by” to open the list; as the cursor moves over options, a single highlight slides along. Arrow keys, Enter and Esc work, and clicking outside closes it.

text.zh-TW: 整個清單只有一塊高亮底色。移到哪個選項就把它的 y 丟給 quickTo，連續移動時會很順地跟過去。
text.en: The list has a single highlight. Each option hovered sends its y to quickTo, so the highlight glides smoothly as you move.

text.zh-TW: quickTo 的第二個值是「起點」。打開選單時起點和終點都設成目前選的那項，高亮直接出現在那裡，不會從頂端滑下來。
text.en: quickTo’s second value is the start. On open, start and end are the current choice, so the highlight appears there instead of sliding from the top.

text.zh-TW: 展開時從稍微壓扁的狀態長出來，transform-origin 設在上方，看起來像從按鈕底下拉出來。
text.en: It opens from slightly squashed with transform-origin at the top, as if pulled out from under the button.

text.zh-TW: 焦點留在清單上，用 aria-activedescendant 告訴讀屏軟體目前停在哪個選項，方向鍵移動時才唸得出來。
text.en: Focus stays on the list and aria-activedescendant tells screen readers which option is active, so arrow keys are announced.
